title: Apple just quietly killed off a bunch of older iPhone and Apple Watch models - here are the products that are gone forever (AAPL)
text: Apple just quietly killed off a bunch of older iPhone and Apple Watch models — here are the products that are gone forever (AAPL) By Avery Hartmans Sep 13, 2018, 5:39 pm 20 pts Apple's annual hardware event may have been an exciting day for gadget lovers, as three new iPhones were introduced. But it was a sad day for those diehard fans of Apple's older products, as the Cupertino tech giant took the chance to clean house. Apple quietly killed off half a dozen of its older…
